title: New law: An Act to promote the separation of constitutional powers by suspending the effectiveness of the Rules of Evidence for United States Courts and Magistrates, the amendments to the Federal Rules of Civil Procedure, and the Amendments to the Federal Rules of Criminal Procedure transmitted to the Congress by the Chief Justice on February 5, 1973, until approved by Act of Congress. (Public Law 93-12)
summary: S. 583 of the 93rd Congress became Public Law 93-12 on 1973-03-30.

title: New law: A bill to amend the National School Lunch Act to assure that Federal financial assistance to the child nutrition programs is maintained at the level budgeted for fiscal year ending June 30, 1973. (Public Law 93-13)
summary: H.R. 4278 of the 93rd Congress became Public Law 93-13 on 1973-03-30.

title: New law: A bill to amend the joint resolution establishing the American Revolution Bicentennial Commission, as amended. (Public Law 93-11)
summary: H.R. 3694 of the 93rd Congress became Public Law 93-11 on 1973-03-15.

title: New law: Joint resolution to provide for the designation of the second full calendar week in March 1973 as "National Employ the Older Worker Week". (Public Law 93-10)
summary: H.J.Res. 334 of the 93rd Congress became Public Law 93-10 on 1973-03-15.

title: New law: Joint resolution making further continuing appropriations for the fiscal year 1973, and for other purposes. (Public Law 93-9)
summary: H.J.Res. 345 of the 93rd Congress became Public Law 93-9 on 1973-03-08.
